decision: R4 NEXP_DIRECT_LANES4 on best R2; do not implement 1KiB A cache in this round

cache_screening.scope: Optimistic necessary-byte diagnostic with unchanged non-target spans and DDR traffic; not cache simulation, not general mathematical upper bound. New tag/copy/snoop/stale-fill costs excluded.

N4_screening.scope: Design screening only. Requires actual lane4 NX32 wrapper initiation-interval calibration; no fee is entered into model before measurement.

reasons: Cache payoff over bestR2 limited under unchanged trace/DMA, despite material cumulative S work reduction.
Cache needs physical tag invalidation at accepted writes, pending miss kill semantics, and actual old-DMA local destination/timing mapping.
N4 retains current S32 frame ABI and numeric contract, existing S/cache/DDR services, default2 and DIRECT0 compatibility.
Keep measured negative result if actual costs do not improve; no gain presumed.
